narratives.Overview:
## Parent

#2761

## What to build

Bind product-signal consent to the exact telemetry destination so a project-controlled `sinkRepo` cannot use the operator's `gh` token as a confused deputy. Preserve intentional custom-sink capability by amending consent (schema v2) rather than removing overrides.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Consent schema v2 records the exact normalized `owner/repo` sink
- [ ] Existing v1 consent authorizes only the baked-in default `deftai/product-signal`, never a custom project sink
- [ ] Destination authorization runs immediately before adapter construction / network use (including dry-run); `skipGates` cannot bypass it
- [ ] Changing `plan.policy.productSignal.sinkRepo` after consent soft-skips (e.g. `sink-unconsented`) until the exact destination is re-consented
- [ ] Consent/status commands show configured sink, consented sink, and whether they match
- [ ] Docs + product-signal skill pack source updated; derived content regenerated (`task packs:render` / `task verify:pack-drift`)
- [ ] Regression tests cover v1+default allow, v1+custom deny, v2 match allow, v2 mismatch deny-before-adapter, normalization, and headless fail-open
- [ ] `task check` passes

## Type

AFK

## Blocked by

None — independent trust boundary; recommended merge after A and B for review-surface sizing
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Extend the product-signal consent schema/module under packages/core/src/product-signal/ so v2 records normalized sinkRepo and authorize before adapter construction in submit.ts. 2) Add fixture tests in packages/core/src/product-signal/submit.test.ts that verify v1 custom sinks are rejected and mismatched v2 sinks emit sink-unconsented without network calls.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft operator, I want product-signal consent bound to the exact sinkRepo, so that changing the destination requires explicit re-consent before telemetry posts.
